fields.reasoning: QA's cycle-4 finding was confirmed by its critic. After request-changes, signoff goes back to review/review, and the fix cycle's verifier and checks then commit Evidence and actor records that nothing renders before ship open-pr pushes. So the re-pushed PR fails rhiza check in CI, and the run fails at pr-green. A render step just before open-pr covers both paths with one rule. The answered cycle had failed, so the question was escalated to the owner, who picked this option.
fields.statement: Ship-change renders again right before every push. A second render command step sits between the review workflow step and open-pr (review, then render-pr, then open-pr). It runs rhiza render and commits .rhiza/rendered and the uncommitted .rhiza/log entries, like the render step after build. signoff's on.changes stays review/review, so the push after request-changes is rendered too. run-ship-signoff clones the head re-pushed after request-changes and runs rhiza check on it. Leaf ship-change-file's statement names both render steps.
fields.wording: the agent's option, picked by the owner: "Render before open-pr (Recommended)" (add a second render step between review and open-pr, so the first push and every push after request-changes is rendered and committed; extend run-ship-signoff to clone the re-pushed head and run rhiza check)
